summary: An unidentified Loveland man and his 13-year-old son summited Longs Peak via the Keyhole Route and got off route descending Clark Arrow through the Loft between Longs Peak and Mount Meeker in sub-freezing temperatures and high winds; the father called rangers on a cellphone; RMNP SAR staff reached them ~10:30 pm and assisted them to a backcountry shelter near Chasm Lake by 2 am, hiking out Monday morning
location: Clark Arrow / The Loft between Longs Peak and Mount Meeker
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: Reporter-Herald (beaconjournal) 2015-11-09 parent-opened run 633. 2015-11-08 verified Sunday; names withheld because the son is a juvenile.
